reviews.text: I was really happy when they showed up on time, explained the process and cleaned the ducts in less than 2 hours after a bad experience with another contractor! The tech also pointed out a few minor things to watch for, which was good to know for maintenance down the road.
reviews.author: Shirley Ballard

reviews.text: So incredibly grateful to team Turlington! Very responsive, professional, and beyond fairly priced.
reviews.author: Nancy D.

reviews.text: Came home from work on one of the hottest day of the summer to a not functioning AC unit!! Called Turlington, someone came out within the hour. Repaired it in less time than it took for him to arrive at my house. Super nice and explained everything that was wrong and what was done to repair it. Very reasonable price too!!
reviews.author: Rob B.
